## Solidity Test Runner Integratin Test Suite

A test suite that tests different aspects of the Solidity test runner.

### Structure

- [`core`](default/core): Tests for fundamental aspects of the Solidity test runner
- [`logs`](default/logs): Tests for logging capabilities
- [`cheats`](default/cheats): Tests for cheatcodes
- [`fuzz`](default/fuzz): Tests for the fuzzer
- [`trace`](default/trace): Tests for the tracer
- [`fork`](default/fork): Tests for the Solidity test runner's forking capabilities
